research.title: Predictive Uncertainty Under Changing Missingness Patterns
bullets: Formulated a research question on uncertainty calibration when feature missingness patterns differ between training and deployment populations.
Led development of a missingness-aware calibration procedure, comparing pooled and pattern-conditioned residual quantiles under simulated changes in feature availability.

research.title: Stable Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Formulated research questions about unstable importance weights in conformal regression and led development of regularized density-ratio weighting procedures.
Designed comparisons of weight clipping, calibration sample reuse, and overlap diagnostics, examining empirical coverage and interval width across controlled distribution shifts.

publications.title: Regularized Density-Ratio Weighting for Conformal Regression Under Covariate Shift
Overlap Diagnostics and Calibration Sample Reuse in Weighted Conformal Regression
Weight Clipping and Coverage Sensitivity in Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift

work.title: Data Validation and Batch Processing Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for incoming tabular records, handling missing fields, inconsistent types, and duplicate identifiers within existing batch processing workflows.
Added regression tests for parsing failures and revised error messages, documenting reproduction steps and expected behavior for maintenance handoffs.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Probabilistic Classifier Calibration
bullets: Implemented logistic regression and neural network classifiers, applying temperature scaling and isotonic regression to held-out predictions.
Compared reliability diagrams, log loss, and calibration error across class imbalance settings, keeping preprocessing and evaluation splits consistent.

projects.title: Sparse Regression With Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented coordinate descent for lasso regression and compared fitted models with ridge and elastic net baselines.
Evaluated prediction error and coefficient stability on synthetic correlated designs, selecting regularization parameters through cross-validation without using test observations.

projects.title: Approximate Inference for Bayesian Logistic Regression
bullets: Implemented Laplace approximation and mean-field variational inference for Bayesian logistic regression using a shared Gaussian prior specification.
Compared posterior predictive probabilities, uncertainty estimates, and optimization behavior across sample regimes, checking sensitivity to initialization and prior scale.

projects.title: Kernel Two-Sample Testing for Distribution Shift
bullets: Implemented maximum mean discrepancy tests with permutation calibration and compared them against classifier-based tests for detecting distribution changes.
Evaluated false positive behavior and detection sensitivity under simulated location, scale, and mixture shifts, examining effects of kernel bandwidth selection.
